Government.Name: Pirates
Government.Description:
Balanced Pirates are not strongly focussed in any one area. They are versatile and can try a bit of everything, but they are best at espionage, contracts and income gained through influence and corruption.

They attempt to control colonies, gain income from protection arrangements with other empires, and capture enemy ships and bases.

Balanced Pirates start with more advanced tech for Crew Quarters and Command Centers.

Government.Name: Smugglers
Government.Description:
Smugglers are focussed on trading resources to other factions.

They typically also build a network of mining stations to supply key resources that they can then sell to others.

Smugglers value stability and peaceful coexistence with other factions instead of open conflict. They also make good use of influence from hidden planetary bases to gain economic advantages.

Smugglers also enjoy an extra 10% discount on the price of Black Market resources.

Smugglers start with more advanced tech for Engines and Cargo Bays.

Government.Name: Raiders
Government.Description:
Raiders attempt to control colonies by force, both independent and those owned by standard empires. They grow rich through repeated raids and gaining local influence from raiding which siphons off the wealth from these controlled colonies.

To cement their control they fight off competing rival pirates and often capture their ships and bases.

Raiders start with more advanced tech for Assault Pods and Tractor Beams.

Government.Name: Mercenaries
Government.Description:
Mercenaries are the most disciplined and militaristic of the pirates, descended from the surviving fleets of the ancient galaxy. They are now guns for hire who seek out attack, defense and privateering opportunities offered by others.

When not carrying out contracts, they build up their fleets and strengthen their bases through trade and research. Mercenaries may also raid colonies and bases for loot.

Mercenaries start with more advanced tech for Military Ship Hulls and Fighter Bays.

Government.Name: Fringe Confederacy
Government.Description: Fringe Confederacy is a transitional government between Balanced Pirates and other standard empire government styles. It combines some of the advantages of piracy with the increased stability and structure of planetary civilization.\n\nOnce a pirate faction switches to this form of government other more typical styles of planetary government become available (Democracy, Republic, Monarchy, etc). The faction can then choose to subsequently switch to these other governments.

Government.Name: Trade
Government.Description: Trade Guild is a transitional government between Smugglers and other standard empire government styles. It combines some of the advantages of smuggling with the increased stability and structure of planetary civilization.\n\nOnce a smuggling faction switches to this form of government other more typical styles of planetary government become available (Democracy, Republic, Monarchy, etc). The faction can then choose to subsequently switch to these other governments.

Government.Name: Banditocracy
Government.Description: Banditocracy is a transitional government between Raiders and other standard empire government styles. It combines some of the advantages of raiding with the increased stability and structure of planetary civilization.\n\nOnce a raiding faction switches to this form of government other more typical styles of planetary government become available (Democracy, Republic, Monarchy, etc). The faction can then choose to subsequently switch to these other governments.

Government.Name: Frontier Authority
Government.Description: Frontier Authority is a transitional government between Mercenaries and other standard empire government styles. It combines some of the advantages of bounty hunting with the increased stability and structure of planetary civilization.\n\nOnce a mercenary faction switches to this form of government other more typical styles of planetary government become available (Democracy, Republic, Monarchy, etc). The faction can then choose to subsequently switch to these other governments.

Government.Name: Free Anarchy
Government.Description:
Free Anarchy is the pinnacle of pirate governance. It combines all of the advantages of the different styles of piracy (Pirates, Smugglers, Raiders, Mercenaries) into a single form of government.

Free Anarchy is enabled by building the Anarchopolis pirate wonder at a colony. This wonder can only be built by upgrading an existing Criminal Network facility.

The leader of a pirate faction with this government is considered to be the defacto authority for all pirates, and thus gains a permanent diplomatic bonus with all other pirate factions.
